title: AlphaFold-driven structure-based drug discovery: Capabilities, benchmarks and limitations for medicinal chemistry.
snippet: Structure-based drug discovery (SBDD) has become an indispensable tool of medicinal chemistry due to the possibility of rational drug design based on the three-dimensional structure of the biological target.
